## Problem

Describe what is wrong. During the scaffold phase, identify the affected document or path.

## Reproduction

List the steps and expected versus actual result.

## Context

Include relevant platform/version information only if an implementation exists. Use synthetic event data.

## Evidence

Attach safe excerpts or screenshots with secrets and personal data removed.

## Scope note

All application and test files are currently empty by design. Report security vulnerabilities privately using SECURITY.md rather than this template.
